df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# check price jumps for ALL resources on 2025-10-20 vs prior
base = acc[(acc.date>='2025-10-01')&(acc.date<='2025-10-19')]
bp = base.groupby(keycols)['price'].agg(['mean','max'])
d0p = acc[acc.date=='2025-10-20'].groupby(keycols)['price'].max()

comp['jump'] = comp['day_price']>comp['max']+1e-9
print(comp[comp.jump][['mean','max','day_price']])

# instance count check: mean of num_instances baseline vs day
bn = base.groupby(keycols)['num_instances'].mean()
d0n = acc[acc.date=='2025-10-20'].groupby(keycols)['num_instances'].sum()
compn = bn.to_frame('mean_n').join(d0n.rename('day_n')).fillna(0)
compn['ratio'] = compn['day_n']/compn['mean_n']
print(compn[compn.ratio>2.5].sort_values('ratio',ascending=False))

acc = df[df.account_id=='sBGaYvw'].copy()
keycols = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']

base = acc[(acc.date>='2025-10-01')&(acc.date<='2025-10-18')]
bm = base.groupby(keycols)['unblended_cost'].agg(['mean','std'])
d0 = acc[acc.date=='2025-10-20'].groupby(keycols)['unblended_cost'].sum()
comp = bm.join(d0.rename('day')).fillna(0)
comp['delta'] = comp['day']-comp['mean']
z = (comp['delta']/comp['std'].replace(0,np.nan)).abs()
out = comp.assign(z=z).sort_values('delta', ascending=False)
suspects = out[out.z>3]
for (csp,cs,app,ifam) in suspects.index:
    sub = acc[(acc.csp==csp)&(acc.cloud_service==cs)&(acc.application==app)&(acc.instance_family==ifam)]
    s = sub[(sub.date>='2025-10-18')&(sub.date<='2025-10-24')]
    print(csp,cs,app,ifam)
    print(s[['date','unblended_cost','num_instances','price']].to_string())
"}

compn = bn.to_frame('mean_n').join(d0n.rename('day_n')).fillna(0)
compn['ratio'] = compn['day_n']/compn['mean_n']
print(compn[compn.ratio>2.5].sort_values('ratio',ascending=False))

print(comp[comp.day_price>comp.base_price+1e-9])

daily = acc.groupby('date')['unblended_cost'].sum().sort_index()

print("Anomaly day (Oct 20) cost:", daily['2025-10-20'])
print("Excess vs baseline:", round(daily['2025-10-20']-baseline,2))
